reason: Verification failed with a critical missing metric and several major gaps versus the specification. With two iterations remaining (34/36), there is high potential to reach spec compliance if we prioritize must-have features: subgroup adoption metrics and convergence validation, plus minimal implementations of location-level enforcement parameters and media influence. Addressing these will likely flip implementation_check to true and substantially improve validation readiness.

specific_areas: Implement 'subgroup_adoption_rate' metric: by income_decile (already available), and add age_group and occupation_type to Individuals to compute subgroup rates.
Add convergence validation: sliding-window adoption change vs. convergence_epsilon; expose boolean and window stats in Simulation.validate().
Map location-level enforcement parameters: entry_check_probability, warning_probability, fine_probability, fine_amount; simulate per-visit checks, warnings/fines, and track incidents.
Extend Individual attributes: age_group, occupation_type, political_affiliation, information_source_weights; integrate into visit patterns and media weighting.
Enhance MediaChannel: message_slant, message_intensity, reach; apply effects on risk perception and trust weighted by information_source_weights.
Improve mask purchasing behavior: explicitly use price and income, include purchase_limit_per_visit, scale desired quantity with perceived risk; log attempted demand.
Fix 'mask_shortage_days' to count days when aggregate attempted demand exceeds available supply.
Minor cleanup: remove superfluous 'pass' statements; add input edge-case guards; clarify whether day 0 is included in metrics documentation.

task_understanding.adjustments: Reprioritize to implement spec-mandatory items first: subgroup_adoption_rate and convergence validation. Treat location enforcement parameters as minimal viable features required for compliance; defer nonessential enhancements.

data_analysis.adjustments: Define simple priors for age_group and occupation_type distributions (e.g., configurable categorical probabilities). Establish reasonable default information_source_weights across media/public health/social sources. Prepare bins for income_deciles consistent with existing income generation.

model_planning.adjustments: Add a lightweight Location enforcement model layered onto existing Workplace/School with entry_check_probability, warning_probability, fine_probability, fine_amount, and mask_requirement. Specify convergence window (e.g., last 7–14 days) and epsilon threshold from config. Plan interfaces so new attributes have defaults for backward compatibility.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement new Individual fields with safe defaults; update serialization and initialization routines. Add MediaChannel fields and apply effects in step(). Implement purchase logic using price, income, and purchase_limit_per_visit. Add daily aggregation for attempted demand and enforcement incidents. Maintain deterministic behavior via seeding. Update config schema and inline docs.

code_verification.adjustments: Add unit/integration checks for: subgroup_adoption_rate presence and correctness; convergence_criterion boolean logic; enforcement incident counters; mask_shortage_days using demand>stock; regression test that simulation still runs with prior configs. Include assertions on metric shapes and non-negativity.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run shorter smoke simulations to validate new metrics, then one standard-duration run to ensure convergence metric behavior. Log daily totals for attempted demand, supply, warnings, and fines for debugging.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Report subgroup adoption by income_decile, age_group, and occupation_type; include convergence assessment (window, epsilon, boolean); report enforcement metrics (checks, warnings, fines) and noncompliance rates; clarify day indexing in outputs.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Confirm closure of critical and top-priority major issues. If scope risers occur, document any deferred items (e.g., richer media ecosystems or political affiliation effects) with a follow-up plan.
